notes.title: How it is computed
notes.amounts: Amounts are TRY, VAT inclusive; days follow the Europe/Istanbul calendar.
notes.basis_accrual: Accrual basis: rent and charge accruals posted in the period, net of reversals; expenses by document date.
notes.basis_cash: Cash basis: collections in the period (net of voids and refunds, classified by the rental's accruals), expenses and supplier payments in the period.
notes.allocation_rental_days: Branch expenses without a vehicle go to that branch's vehicles, head-office expenses to the whole fleet, each month by rental days.
notes.allocation_vehicle_count: Branch expenses without a vehicle go to that branch's vehicles, head-office expenses to the whole fleet, each month equally to the vehicles in service.
notes.allocation_revenue: Branch expenses without a vehicle go to that branch's vehicles, head-office expenses to the whole fleet, each month by gross income share.
notes.swap: A rental with a vehicle swap splits its income, commissions and kept-apart classes across the vehicles by time on each leg. Commissions follow the rental's income over the periods.
notes.kept_apart: Refunded collections, deposits, tolls re-billed to customers and vehicle procurement are neither income nor cost; they are shown apart.
notes.overhead_branches: Only the shared overhead of your branches is included; head-office overhead is not.
notes.fallback: In months where the chosen method had no weight, overhead was allocated by vehicle count.
notes.unallocated: {{amount}} of overhead of branches without a vehicle in service could not be allocated.
